name: AI Coding Agent Training Suite
description: A curated set of software-engineering tasks designed for code generation, bug fixing, security review, translation, and reasoning benchmarks.

tasks.prompt: Fix the bug in this function. It should return the median value from a list of numbers, but it currently fails on even-length lists because it uses the wrong index and the function can also crash on an empty list.
Implement a function that returns the nth Fibonacci number using iterative arithmetic, with O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
Translate the Python function below that computes a rolling sum into TypeScript. Preserve the API semantics and include type annotations.
Review this token transfer function. It must prevent reentrancy and should only allow transfers to valid addresses. Provide the corrected implementation.
Write a JUnit test suite for the function isPrime(int n). The tests should cover zero, one, negative numbers, and known prime/composite values.
Optimize the function that checks whether a string contains duplicate characters. It must remain correct and should avoid quadratic behavior on large inputs.
Refactor the code so that it uses a slice-based API and eliminates repeated bounds checks while preserving the same behavior.
Implement a function that flattens a nested list structure using recursion while preserving the original order of elements.

The function below should deduplicate an array while preserving insertion order. It currently returns duplicates because it compares against the wrong object identity and it also fails when the elements are objects.
Refactor the code to remove duplicated dictionary logic and make it easier to extend to more data fields without repeated branches.
